Abana badafite ibyo bibazo bashobora kuvurirwa mu rugo bahabwa RUTF kandi bakajya kwa muganga buri cyumweru. Abaganga bazasuzuma umwana bakugire inama y'aho akwiye kuvurirwa.

question: Abajyanama b'ubuzima bafasha bate mu kurwanya imirire mibi?
answer: Abajyanama b'ubuzima batuye mu mudugudu wawe kandi bafasha mu buryo bwinshi: bapima abana ibiro n'uburebure buri kwezi, bapima ukuboko bakoresheje MUAC, bagira inama ku konsa no kugaburira abana, berekana uko bateka amafunguro afite intungamubiri, basura ingo gukurikirana abana barwaye cyangwa bafite imirire mibi, kandi bohereza ku kigo nderabuzima abana bafite ibimenyetso by'akaga. Ushobora kubitabaza igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

question: Kuki ari ingenzi gukurikiza inama z'umuforomo nyuma yo kubyara?
answer: Gukurikiza inama z'abaganga biha umwana wawe intangiriro nziza: konsa neza birinda ibibazo, inkingo zitangwa ku gihe zirinda indwara, gukurikirana imikurire bimenya ibibazo hakiri kare, inama ku mirire zifasha umwana gukura neza, kandi isuzuma nyuma yo kubyara rimenya ibibazo by'ubuzima. Abaforomo n'abaganga bize kugufasha kwita ku mwana wavutse. Inama zabo zishingiye ku bikorwa byagaragaje ko birokora ubuzima kandi birinda imirire mibi.

question: Nkore iki niba ntumva neza amabwiriza y'umuganga?
answer: Buri gihe baza ibibazo niba udasobanukiwe: saba ko bagusobanurira mu magambo yoroshye, ubasabe kukwereka uko bikorwa (nko konsa cyangwa gutanga umuti), wandike amabwiriza cyangwa usabe impapuro ziyanditseho, uzane umuntu wo mu muryango ugufasha, usubiremo ibyo wumvise kugira ngo ubyemeze, ubaze icyo wakora haramutse habaye ikibazo, kandi usabe igihe cyo kugaruka niba bikenewe. Abaganga bifuza kugufasha; ntutinye gusaba ibisobanuro.

question: Kugaruka kwa muganga ku mwana ufite imirire mibi bifite akahe kamaro?
answer: Kugaruka kwa muganga ni ingenzi cyane: bikurikirana uko ibiro byiyongera n'uko umwana akira, bituma ubuvuzi buhindurwa igihe bikenewe, bimenya ibibazo hakiri kare, bigufasha kubona inama, bikakwemeza ko ubona ibikenewe (RUTF, imiti), kandi birinda ko imirire mibi igaruka. Gusiba gahunda bishobora gutuma ubuvuzi butagira akamaro. Jya kwa muganga igihe cyose bakuhamagaye, n'iyo umwana yaba asa n'uworohewe. Gukira neza bifata igihe.

question: Ni iyihe miti cyangwa inyongera umwana wanjye ufite imirire mibi akwiye gufata?
answer: Abaganga bakunze kwandika: antibiyotike (zo kuvura ubwandu), vitamini A (irinda indwara kandi ifasha amaso), aside folike (ifasha mu gukora amaraso), ubutare (mu gihe cyo gukira), imiti y'inzoka, n'izindi vitamini cyangwa imyunyu ngugu igihe bikenewe. Tanga imiti yose nk'uko yanditswe, urangize imiti yose n'iyo umwana yaba asa n'uwakize, kandi uvuge ingaruka zose ubonye. Ntugasangire imiti cyangwa ngo uhe umwana imiti y'abantu bakuru.

question: Nakora nte ngo umwana wanjye arangize ubuvuzi bwose bw'imirire mibi?
answer: Kugira ngo arangize ubuvuzi: jya kwa muganga igihe cyose bagutumiye, utange imiti nk'uko yanditswe, ukurikize inama zo kumugaburira, ubike neza ikarita ya gahunda, ubwire abaganga ibibazo byose, ntuhagarike ubuvuzi kubera ko umwana asa n'uworohewe (rangiza gahunda yose), ushyire umuryango mu kwita ku mwana, ushake ibisubizo by'ibikubuza kujya kwa muganga (urugendo, akazi), kandi wumve ko gukira neza bishobora gufata amezi 2 kugeza kuri 3. Ubuvuzi butarangiye akenshi butuma imirire mibi igaruka.

question: Umwana wanjye ufite imirire mibi yanga kurya. Nkore iki?
answer: Gerageza ibi: umuhe amafunguro mato kenshi aho kuba manini, utegure ibiryo bisa neza bifite amabara, murire hamwe nk'umuryango, umuhe ibiryo akunda wongeyemo amavuta cyangwa ubunyobwa biseye, wihangane kandi ntumuhatire, umugaburire igihe akangutse kandi yishimye, ushyushye ibiryo (abana bakunda ibiryo bishyushye), ugabanye ibimurangaza mu gihe cyo kurya, umushimire uko agize icyo arya, kandi urebe ko atarwaye (ubwandu bugabanya apeti). Niba apeti itagarutse mu minsi 2 cyangwa 3, jya kwa muganga.

question: Nshobora gukomeza imigenzo ya gakondo mu gihe umwana avurwa imirire mibi?
answer: Komeza imigenzo myiza nko kwita by'umwihariko ku mwana urwaye, ibiryo byihariye bifasha gukira, gushyushya umwana, no gufashwa n'abaturanyi. Ariko wirinde imigenzo mibi nko kwima umwana ibiryo igihe arwaye, gukoresha imiti y'ibyatsi gusa aho kumuvuza kwa muganga, guhagarika konsa, kujugunya umuhondo (amashereka ya mbere), cyangwa kubuza abana bato n'ababyeyi kurya ibiryo bimwe. Ganira n'abaganga ku migenzo ya gakondo kugira ngo mumenye iyizewe kandi ifite akamaro.

question: Nabona nte ubushobozi bwo kugurira umwana wanjye ufite imirire mibi ibiryo bifite intungamubiri?
answer: Gira imirire myiza idahenze: koresha ibyubaka umubiri bidahenze nk'ibishyimbo, amashaza n'amagi; ugure imboga n'imbuto z'igihembwe; uhinge imboga mu karima k'igikoni niba bishoboka; wongeremo amavuta adahenze kugira ngo wongere imbaraga; ukoreshe ibiryo byo mu gace utuyemo aho kugura ibiryo bihenze byatunganyijwe mu nganda; ushake ibiryo byo kuvura bitangwa ku buntu mu bigo nderabuzima; witabire gahunda z'ubufasha mu biribwa; kandi wibande ku biryo bifite intungamubiri nyinshi aho kwibanda ku bwinshi. Ibiryo bike bifite intungamubiri biruta byinshi bidafite intungamubiri.

question: Umwana ufite imirire mibi amara igihe kingana iki ngo akire?
answer: Igihe cyo gukira kiratandukana: imirire mibi yoroheje cyangwa iringaniye ishobora gukira mu mezi 2 kugeza kuri 3 umwana agaburirwa neza. Imirire mibi ikabije akenshi isaba ibyumweru 6 kugeza ku 8 mu buvuzi, ariko gukira neza kose harimo no kongera gukura bishobora gufata amezi 3 kugeza kuri 6 cyangwa arenga. Komeza ubuvuzi kugeza abaganga bemeje ko umwana yakize neza. Abana bakize neza kandi bavuwe kare bashobora kubaho ubuzima busanzwe kandi buzira umuze.

question: Umwana ufite imirire mibi akeneye kwitabwaho ate mu marangamutima?
answer: Abana bafite imirire mibi bakeneye: gukorwaho n'urukundo no guterurwa, gukina n'ibikorwa bibakangura ubwenge, kuvugishwa neza kandi babatera inkunga, kwihanganirwa (bashobora kurakara cyangwa kwigunga), kugaburirwa nta guhatirwa, gushyirwa mu bikorwa by'umuryango, ahantu hatuje kandi hatanga umutekano, kwitabwaho buri gihe mu buryo bumwe, no kurindwa guhangayika. Kwitabwaho mu marangamutima ni ingenzi nk'imirire: bifasha ubwonko gukura, bishishikariza umwana kurya kandi bifasha gukira. Mwereke urukundo igihe cyose cy'ubuvuzi.

question: Abagabo bafasha bate mu kurinda abana imirire mibi?
answer: Ababyeyi b'abagabo bafite uruhare runini: bashyigikira konsa bafasha imirimo yo mu rugo, baherekeza umubyeyi n'umwana kwa muganga, bazana ibiryo bifite intungamubiri mu rugo, bafasha kwita ku bana kugira ngo umubyeyi atananirwa, bitabira inyigisho ku mirire, bafasha kugaburira abana bakuru, birinda ihohoterwa mu rugo, bashyigikira ubuzima bw'umubyeyi igihe atwite n'igihe yonsa, kandi baba intangarugero mu kurengera imirire y'abana mu muryango.

question: Kuboneza urubyaro bifasha bite kwirinda imirire mibi?
answer: Gusiga nibura imyaka 2 kugeza kuri 3 hagati y'inda imwe n'indi birinda imirire mibi kuko: bituma umubyeyi agarura imbaraga n'intungamubiri, buri mwana akonka bihagije (imyaka 2), umwana ntacutswa imburagihe kubera undi uje, buri mwana akitabwaho bihagije, umuryango ntuhure n'ibibazo by'ubukungu byinshi, kandi ubuzima bw'umubyeyi bukaba bwiza. Kubyara mu bihe biteganyijwe bituma ababyeyi n'abana bagira ubuzima bwiza. Ganira n'abaganga ku kuboneza urubyaro.

question: Amazi meza afite uruhe ruhare mu kwirinda imirire mibi?
answer: Amazi meza arinda imirire mibi kuko: agabanya indwara z'impiswi zituma umubiri utakaza intungamubiri, arinda inzoka zirya intungamubiri z'umwana, atuma ibiryo bitegurwa neza, afasha mu isuku, kandi arinda ubuzima. Koresha amazi yatetswe cyangwa yasukuwe mu kunywa no guteka. Bika amazi mu bikoresho bisukuye kandi bipfundikiye. Rinda amasoko y'amazi kwandura. Igisha abana kutanywa amazi aturuka ahantu hatizewe.

question: Abaturage bafatanya bate mu kurwanya imirire mibi?
answer: Abaturage bashobora: gutegura inyigisho z'imirire no kwerekana uko bateka mu gikoni cy'umudugudu, gushyiraho uturima tw'igikoni, gushinga amatsinda y'ababyeyi bafashanya, gusangira ubumenyi ku kugaburira abana, kumenya no gufasha imiryango itishoboye, gushishikariza konsa gusa, kubona amazi meza n'isuku, gushyigikira gahunda zo kuvura imirire mibi, gupimisha abana buri gihe, no guharanira gahunda z'imirire. Ibikorwa rusange byongera imbaraga z'umuntu ku giti cye kandi bigatuma abana bagira imirire myiza.

question: Abagore batwite bakwiye kurya iki kugira ngo barinde abana babo imirire mibi?
answer: Abagore batwite bakwiye kurya: ifunguro ry'inyongera buri munsi, ibiryo bikungahaye ku butare (inyama zitukura, umwijima, imboga z'icyatsi, ibishyimbo), ibiryo bikungahaye kuri aside folike (imboga z'amababi, ibinyamisogwe), ibiryo bitanga kalisiyumu (amata, ikivuguto, udufi duto turiwe n'amagufa), ibiryo bikungahaye kuri vitamini A (imboga z'umuhondo, amagi, amata), poroteyine ihagije (inyama, amafi, amagi, ibishyimbo), n'imbuto n'imboga nyinshi. Nywa buri munsi ibinini by'ubutare na aside folike wahawe. Imirire myiza y'umubyeyi utwite ni yo shingiro ry'umwana muzima.

question: Ni irihe tandukaniro hagati ya marasmus na bwaki?
answer: Marasmus ni ukunanuka bikabije umwana akagaragara nk'amagufa gusa, nta kubyimba, biterwa no kubura imbaraga mu biryo igihe kirekire. Bwaki (kwashiorkor) igaragazwa no kubyimba, uruhu ruhinduka n'umwijima munini, biterwa ahanini no kubura poroteyine. Zombi ni imirire mibi ikabije isaba kuvurwa byihuse, nubwo uburyo bwo kuzivura butandukanaho gato.

question: Umwana ashobora kugira marasmus na bwaki icyarimwe?
answer: Yego, ibi byitwa marasmic-kwashiorkor. Abana bagaragaza ukunanuka bikabije hamwe no kubyimba. Bagira ibimenyetso by'ubwoko bwombi: ibiro bike cyane, amagufa agaragara, no kubyimba amaboko n'ibirenge. Ni imirire mibi ikabije isaba kuvurirwa mu bitaro ako kanya.

question: Imirire mibi iringaniye (MAM) ni iki?
answer: Imirire mibi iringaniye bisobanura ko umwana ananutse kurusha uko bikwiye ariko ataragera ku mirire mibi ikabije. Kuri MUAC igaragara mu ibara ry'umuhondo (cm 11.5 kugeza kuri 12.5), cyangwa ibiro ugereranyije n'uburebure biri hagati ya -3 na -2 ku gishushanyo cy'imikurire. Abana bafite imirire mibi iringaniye akenshi bavurirwa mu rugo bahabwa ibiryo by'inyongera bifite intungamubiri kandi bakagenzurwa buri gihe. Kubikurikirana kare birinda ko iba ikabije.

question: Imirire mibi ikabije (SAM) ni iki?
answer: Imirire mibi ikabije ni igihe MUAC yerekana ibara ritukura (munsi ya cm 11.5), ibiro ugereranyije n'uburebure biri munsi ya -3 ku gishushanyo cy'imikurire, cyangwa ibirenge byombi bibyimbye kandi gukandaho bigasiga umwobo. Aba bana bafite ibyago byinshi cyane byo gupfa kandi bakeneye kuvurwa ako kanya: mu rugo bahabwa ibiryo byabugenewe byo kuvura niba nta bindi bibazo bafite kandi barya, cyangwa mu bitaro niba bafite ibindi bibazo.

question: Ababyeyi bashobora gukoresha agapimo ka MUAC mu rugo?
answer: Yego, ababyeyi bashobora kwiga gukoresha agapimo ka MUAC mu gusuzuma abana. Pima ukuboko kw'ibumoso hagati y'urutugu n'inkokora, ukuboko kurekuye kumanutse. Niba agapimo kerekanye ibara ritukura cyangwa umuhondo, jya kwa muganga ako kanya. Icyatsi bisobanura ko ari ibisanzwe, ariko ukomeze gupimisha umwana buri kwezi. MUAC iroroshye ku buryo abaturage bashobora kuyikoresha nyuma yo kwigishwa gato.

question: MUAC ikoreshwa ku mwana ufite imyaka ingahe?
answer: Gupima MUAC bisanzwe byemewe ku bana bafite amezi 6 kugeza kuri 59 (kuva ku mezi 6 kugeza ku myaka 5). Ku mwana utarageza ku mezi 6, hakoreshwa ubundi buryo nko kugereranya ibiro n'uburebure no gusuzumwa na muganga. Gahunda zimwe zikoresha MUAC ku mpinja, ariko ibisubizo bisobanurwa mu buryo butandukanye n'ubw'abana bakuru.

question: Imirire mibi ikabije ishobora kuvurirwa mu rugo?
answer: Yego, niba umwana nta bindi bibazo by'ubuzima afite (nta muriro, kubura amazi mu mubiri, guta ubwenge cyangwa guhumeka bigoye), afite apeti kandi arengeje amezi 6, ashobora kuvurirwa mu rugo ahabwa RUTF (ibiryo byabugenewe byo kuvura). Agomba kujya kwa muganga buri cyumweru kugira ngo akurikiranwe. Abana bafite ibindi bibazo bagomba kubanza kuvurirwa mu bitaro.

question: Kuvurirwa mu rugo bifite izihe nyungu?
answer: Kuvurirwa mu rugo bituma: abana baguma mu miryango yabo, ababyeyi bakomeza kwita ku bandi bana no gukora, ikiguzi cyo kurara mu bitaro kigabanuka, abana benshi bavurwa, ibyago byo kwandura indwara zo mu bitaro bigabanuka, kandi umuryango ukigira byinshi. Bigira akamaro ku mirire mibi ikabije idafite ibindi bibazo, umwana agakurikiranwa buri cyumweru kandi agahabwa RUTF.

question: Kuvura imirire mibi ikabije mu rugo bimara igihe kingana iki?
answer: Kuvura mu rugo hakoreshejwe RUTF akenshi bimara ibyumweru 6 kugeza ku 8 kugira ngo umwana agere ku bipimo byo gusezererwa (MUAC irenze cm 12.5 kandi nta kubyimba mu byumweru 2). Bamwe bakira vuba, abandi bagatinda. Kujya kwa muganga buri cyumweru bikurikirana uko akira. Niba nta terambere riboneka mu byumweru 2 cyangwa 3, cyangwa hakagaragara ibindi bibazo, umwana ashobora koherezwa mu bitaro.

question: Kuki abana bafite imirire mibi barwara indwara z'ubwandu byoroshye?
answer: Imirire mibi igabanya ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri: igabanya imikorere y'uturemangingo turwanya indwara, inanura urukuta rw'amara (mikorobe zikinjira byoroshye), igabanya ibirinda indwara mu mubiri, kandi igabanya ubushobozi bw'uruhu n'ibindi bice byo kubuza mikorobe kwinjira. Ibyo bituma abana bafatwa byoroshye n'umusonga, impiswi, malariya, ubwandu bwo mu maraso n'izindi ndwara zongera imirire mibi.

question: Ubwandu bwageze mu maraso (sepsis) ku bana bafite imirire mibi ni iki?
answer: Sepsis ni ubwandu bukomeye bukwira mu maraso kandi bushobora guhitana ubuzima. Ku bana bafite imirire mibi, ibimenyetso bishobora kutagaragara cyane: umwana asinzira cyane cyangwa agacika intege, akonja aho gushyuha, yanga kurya, cyangwa ahumeka vuba. Ubonye kimwe muri ibi, jyana umwana ku bitaro cyangwa ku kigo nderabuzima ako kanya. Bikenera kuvurwa byihuse n'abaganga.

question: Umusonga utandukaniye he ku bana bafite imirire mibi?
answer: Abana bafite imirire mibi barwaye umusonga akenshi ntibagira umuriro mwinshi cyangwa inkorora ikomeye. Ibimenyetso by'ingenzi bishobora kuba guhumeka vuba, igituza kinjira imbere igihe ahumeka, cyangwa umwana ufite intege nke utarya. Bara inshuro ahumeka: ku mwana ufite umwaka 1 kugeza ku myaka 5, guhumeka inshuro 40 cyangwa zirenga ku munota ni vuba. Jyana umwana ku kigo nderabuzima ako kanya.

question: Ni ryari umwana ufite imirire mibi agomba gusuzumwa igituntu?
answer: Saba umuganga gusuzuma igituntu niba umwana wawe amaze ibyumweru birenga bibiri akorora, akomeza gutakaza ibiro n'ubwo arya neza, ababira nijoro cyangwa agira umuriro, cyangwa abana n'umuntu urwaye igituntu. Igituntu gikunze kugaragara ku bana bafite imirire mibi kandi kibabuza gukira. Gusuzuma no kuvura biboneka mu bigo by'ubuvuzi.

question: Malariya igira izihe ngaruka ku bana bafite imirire mibi?
answer: Malariya itera umuriro, kubura apeti, kuruka no kubura amaraso, bityo yongera imirire mibi kandi igatinza gukira. Reba ko umwana aryama mu nzitiramibu iteye umuti buri joro. Niba umwana afite umuriro, mujyane ku mujyanama w'ubuzima cyangwa ku kigo nderabuzima apimwe malariya uwo munsi; ntutegereze cyangwa ngo umuvurire mu rugo atapimwe.

question: Refeeding syndrome ni iki?
answer: Refeeding syndrome ni ikibazo gikomeye gishobora kubaho iyo umwana ufite imirire mibi ikabije ahawe ibiryo byinshi mu buryo butunguranye. Umubiri we ufite intege nke ntushobora kwihanganira iryo hinduka ritunguranye. Ni yo mpamvu kuvura imirire mibi ikabije bitangirira mu kigo cy'ubuvuzi, umwana ahabwa amafunguro mato apimwe neza. Niba umwana wawe afite imirire mibi ikabije, ntugerageze kumugaburira byinshi mu rugo; mujyane ku kigo nderabuzima.

question: Kuki batangira bamuha amafunguro mato kenshi?
answer: Amafunguro mato atangwa kenshi (buri masaha 2 kugeza kuri 4) arinda refeeding syndrome, ntaremereza igifu n'amara bifite intege nke, arinda isukari nke mu maraso n'ubukonje, kandi atuma umubiri uhinduka buhoro buhoro. Uko umwana agenda akira na apeti ikagaruka, ingano y'ibiryo iriyongera buhoro buhoro.

question: Ni iki gihinduka iyo apeti y'umwana wanjye igarutse mu bitaro?
answer: Iyo apeti igarutse, akenshi nyuma y'iminsi 2 kugeza kuri 7, umwana ava ku mata yo kumugarurira intege (F-75) akajya ku mata akungahaye kurushaho (F-100) cyangwa RUTF kugira ngo atangire kwiyongera ibiro vuba. Amafunguro araba manini kandi umwana agashishikarizwa kurya uko ashaka. Ni ikimenyetso cyiza. Komeza konsa, ufashe mu kumugaburira, kandi ukine na we.

question: Kuki zinc ari ingenzi ku bana?
answer: Zinc ifasha abana gukura, kurwanya indwara, gukira ibikomere no kugumana apeti. Inagabanya igihe impiswi imara, ni yo mpamvu abaganga batanga ibinini bya zinc hamwe na ORS iyo umwana arwaye impiswi. Ibiryo bikungahaye kuri zinc ni inyama, umwijima, amafi, amagi, ibishyimbo, ubunyobwa n'ibinyampeke byuzuye nk'amasaka n'uburo. Tanga ibinini bya zinc gusa nk'uko umuganga abigutegetse.

question: Ni ibihe bimenyetso byo kubura vitamini A?
answer: Ibimenyetso birimo kutabona neza mu mwijima cyangwa nijoro (ubuhumyi bwo mu ijoro), amaso yumye cyane, utubara tw'ibara ry'ivu dusa n'ifuro ku gice cyera cy'ijisho, kurwara kenshi no gukura buhoro. Kubura vitamini A gukabije bishobora gutera ubuhumyi, bityo jyana ku kigo nderabuzima umwana ufite ibibazo by'amaso. Birinde uha umwana vitamini A buri mezi atandatu n'ibiryo nk'ibijumba by'umuhondo, karoti, umwembe, ipapayi, imboga z'icyatsi, amagi n'umwijima.

question: Abana bakeneye guhabwa imiti y'inzoka?
answer: Yego. Inzoka zo mu nda zitwara intungamubiri z'umwana kandi zishobora gutera kubura amaraso. Mu Rwanda, abana guhera ku mwaka 1 bahabwa ibinini by'inzoka buri mezi atandatu ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa mu cyumweru cyahariwe ubuzima bw'umubyeyi n'umwana. Abana bafite imirire mibi bahabwa imiti y'inzoka mu gihe bavurwa. Rinda inzoka ukaraba intoki n'isabune, ukoresha ubwiherero, wambara inkweto kandi unywa amazi meza.

question: Kugaburira umwana umwitayeho bisobanura iki?
answer: Kugaburira umwana umwitayeho bisobanura: kumugaburira buhoro wihanganye, kumutera inkunga ariko utamuhatira, kumuvugisha mu gihe arya, kumureba mu maso, kumenya ibimenyetso byerekana ko ashonje cyangwa ko yahaze, kugabanya ibimurangaza, kugerageza ibiryo bitandukanye n'uburyo bunyuranye bwo kubivanga, no gutuma igihe cyo kurya kiba cyiza. Ubu buryo butuma umwana arya byinshi kandi bukarinda ibibazo byo kurya.

question: Ni ayahe mafunguro mato meza ku bana bato?
answer: Amafunguro mato meza ni: umuneke weze, avoka, umwembe, ipapayi, igi ritetse, igikombe cy'amata cyangwa ikivuguto, ibijumba cyangwa imyumbati bitetse hamwe n'ubunyobwa biseye, umugati usizeho avoka, cyangwa capati. Irinde bombo, biswi, fanta n'imitobe y'inganda. Ntugahe ubunyobwa bwose abana batarageza ku myaka 4 kuko bushobora kubaniga; ukoreshe ubunyobwa biseye.

question: Ni ryari abana batangira kurya ibiryo by'umuryango?
answer: Ku mezi 12, abana bashobora kurya ibiryo by'umuryango bihinduriwe uko bimeze: bikatitse aho kuba biseye, ariko bikiri byoroshye kurusha iby'abantu bakuru. Reba ko amafunguro arimo ibyubaka umubiri (inyama, amafi, amagi, ibishyimbo), ibiribwa by'ibanze, imboga n'amavuta. Komeza konsa. Ku myaka 2, abana benshi barya ibiryo bimwe n'iby'abantu bakuru, ariko buri funguro rikagira ibyubaka umubiri n'amavuta.

question: Nakora iki niba uruhinja rutarageza ku mezi 6 rufite imirire mibi?
answer: Uruhinja rutarageza ku mezi 6 rwananutse, rutiyongera ibiro cyangwa rwonka nabi rugomba kubonwa n'abaganga ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ku bitaro byihuse. Abaganga bazasuzuma umwana n'umubyeyi kandi bafashe kongera gutangira cyangwa kongera konsa. Ntuhe uruhinja rutarageza ku mezi 6 amazi, amata y'inka, igikoma cyangwa ibindi biryo keretse umuganga abikugiriyemo inama.

question: Nakora iki niba umubyeyi adashobora konsa?
answer: Banza ukore ibishoboka byose ngo konsa bishoboke: gufata umwana neza no kumushyira ku ibere neza, konsa kenshi, gukama amashereka, kuvura ibibazo by'ubuzima by'umubyeyi, no gukemura ibibazo by'imibereho n'amarangamutima. Niba bidashoboka rwose, koresha amata y'ifu y'abana ateguwe n'amazi meza nk'uko amabwiriza abivuga. Ntuzigere uyabanza. Kugaburira umwana mu gikombe biratekanye kurusha amacupa ku mpinja.

question: Namenya nte ko umwana wanjye ariyongera ibiro bihagije mu gihe avurwa?
answer: Umwana wawe azapimwa ibiro buri gihe mugiye ku kigo nderabuzima. Umuganga azakubwira niba ibiro biri kuzamuka neza. Umwana uri gukira akenshi yiyongera ibiro buri cyumweru. Niba ibiro bidahinduka cyangwa bigabanuka mu byumweru bibiri, umuganga azashakisha impamvu, nk'indwara, gusangira ibiryo byo kuvura, cyangwa amafunguro adahagije. Mubwire ibibazo byose biri mu rugo.

question: Namenya nte ko kubyimba kw'umwana wanjye kwashize?
answer: Kanda buhoro ibikumwe byawe hejuru y'ibirenge byombi mu gihe cy'amasegonda 3. Niba hasigaye umwobo, kubyimba kuracyahari. Kubyimba akenshi kugabanuka mu cyumweru kimwe cyangwa bibiri by'ubuvuzi. Umuganga azabisuzuma buri uko mugiyeyo; mubwire niba kubyimba kwiyongera cyangwa kukagera ku maguru, ku biganza cyangwa mu maso, kuko ibyo bisaba kuvurwa byihuse.

question: Kuki umwana wanjye ashobora kutiyongera ibiro mu gihe avurwa?
answer: Impamvu zikunze kubaho ni: umwana ntarya ingano yose ya RUTF cyangwa ibiryo bya buri munsi, ibiryo bisangirwa n'abavandimwe, umwana afite ubwandu bwihishe nk'igituntu, impiswi cyangwa inzoka, cyangwa amafunguro ya buri munsi ari make. Bwira umuganga ukuri ku bibera mu rugo; azagufasha. Ha RUTF umwana urwaye wenyine kandi umugaburire amafunguro mato kenshi.

question: Isuzuma rya apeti ni iki?
answer: Isuzuma rya apeti rikorerwa ku kigo nderabuzima ku mwana ufite imirire mibi ikabije. Umuganga aha umwana RUTF nke akareba niba ayirya. Umwana uyirya neza akenshi ashobora kuvurirwa mu rugo. Umwana uyanze cyangwa udashobora kurya agomba kuguma mu bitaro. Mu rugo, bwira umuganga niba umwana wawe atakirangiza RUTF ye.

question: Uruhinja rwanjye rukwiye kurya ibiryo bimeze bite ku myaka itandukanye?
paraphrases: Umwana atangira ryari kurya ibiryo bitanoze neza?
answer: Ku mezi 6, muhe ibiryo byoroshye, bifashe kandi biseye neza. Ku mezi 8, muhe ibiryo biseye birimo uduce duto tworoshye, n'ibiryo ashobora gufata n'intoki nk'uduce tw'umuneke cyangwa avoka. Kuva ku mezi 9 kugeza kuri 11, muhe ibiryo by'umuryango bikatitse cyane. Ku mezi 12, abana benshi bashobora kurya ibiryo by'umuryango bikatiwemo uduce duto. Kumuha ibiryo bikomeye uko agenda akura bimufasha kwiga guhekenya.

question: Ni ryari umwana wanjye ashobora kunywa amata y'inka?
paraphrases: Nshobora guha umwana w'amezi 7 amata y'inka?
Amata y'inka ni meza ku ruhinja?
answer: Mbere y'amezi 12, amashereka agomba gukomeza kuba ikinyobwa cy'ingenzi; amata y'inka yatetswe make ashobora gushyirwa mu gikoma guhera ku mezi 6. Guhera ku mezi 12, abana bashobora kunywa amata y'inka yatetswe cyangwa ikivuguto nk'igice cy'indyo yabo. Amata atanga poroteyine na kalisiyumu, ariko ntagomba gusimbura amafunguro cyangwa konka.

question: Ni ibihe biryo byiza umwana ashobora gufata n'intoki akirisha?
paraphrases: Umwana w'amezi 9 yafata iki akirisha?
answer: Kuva ku mezi 8 hafi, abana bakunda kwigaburira. Ibiryo byiza bafata n'intoki ni uduce tworoshye tw'umuneke weze, avoka, ipapayi, ibijumba, karoti cyangwa ibirayi bihiye neza, uduce tw'igi ritetse n'uduce duto twa capati yoroshye. Buri gihe guma iruhande rw'umwana igihe arya. Irinde ibiryo bito, bikomeye kandi biburungushuye nk'ubunyobwa bwose, kuko bishobora kumuniga.

question: Namenya nte ko uruhinja rwanjye rushonje cyangwa rwahaze?
paraphrases: Ibimenyetso byerekana ko umwana yahaze
answer: Umwana ushonje yasama, yegera ikiyiko, arambura ukuboko ku biryo cyangwa akishima iyo abibonye. Umwana wahaze ahindukiza umutwe, afunga umunwa, asunika ibiryo cyangwa akabikiniramo. Kurikiza ibi bimenyetso: muhe ibiryo wihanganye kandi umutere inkunga, ariko ntuzigere umuhatira kurya. Niba umwana wawe akunze kwanga ibiryo cyangwa atakaza ibiro, jya kwa muganga.

question: Imitobe na fanta ni byiza ku bana?
paraphrases: Nshobora guha umwana wanjye fanta?
answer: Oya. Fanta, imitobe y'inganda iryohereye n'ibindi binyobwa birimo isukari bitanga isukari nta ntungamubiri, bigabanya apeti y'ibiryo nyabyo kandi byangiza amenyo. Aho kumuha umutobe, muhe imbuto zose nk'icunga, umwembe, ipapayi cyangwa marakuja. Ibinyobwa byiza ku bana bato ni amashereka, amazi meza n'amata.

question: Nshobora kubika igikoma cy'umwana cyasigaye nkazakimuha nyuma?
paraphrases: Ibiryo by'umwana bitetse bimara igihe kingana iki?
Ni byiza guha umwana igikoma cy'ejo?
answer: Ibiryo bitetse byangirika vuba igihe hashyushye. Igihe bishoboka, gaburira abana ibiryo bitetswe ako kanya, kandi ujugunye ibiryo bimaze amasaha arenga 2 biri hanze, cyangwa ibyo umwana yamaze kuriramo. Niba ugomba kubika ibiryo, bipfundikire, ubibike ahantu hakonje, hanyuma ubishyushye cyane bigashyuha hose, ubireke bihore mbere yo kumugaburira. Ntuzigere utanga ibiryo binuka nabi cyangwa byasharitse.

question: Umwana wanjye akwiye kurira ku isahani y'umuryango cyangwa ku ye?
paraphrases: Ni byiza ko umwana muto asangira isahani n'abavandimwe be?
answer: Ha abana bato isahani cyangwa igikombe byabo. Iyo abana basangiye, umuto akenshi arya bike kuko abakuru barya vuba, kandi ntushobora kumenya ingano yariye. Icarana n'umwana, umufashe kandi umutere inkunga, kandi urebe ko arangiza ingano ihagije irimo ibishyimbo, igi, amafi cyangwa inyama, atari ikiribwa cy'ibanze gusa.

question: Nkwiye gukomeza konsa umwana wanjye amaze kugira umwaka?
paraphrases: Nkwiye konsa kugeza ku myaka ingahe?
answer: Yego. Komeza konsa kugeza ku myaka 2 cyangwa irenga, hamwe n'ibindi biryo. Mu mwaka wa kabiri, amashereka aracyaha umwana hafi kimwe cya gatatu cy'imbaraga akeneye kandi akamurinda indwara. Onsa nyuma y'amafunguro n'igihe umwana abishatse, kandi ukomeze kumuha ibiryo by'umuryango kugira ngo abone intungamubiri zihagije.

question: Igikoma cya sosoma ni iki kandi ni cyiza ku mpinja?
paraphrases: Ifu y'amasaka, soya n'ibigori ni nziza ku bana?
answer: Sosoma ni ifu ivanze ikunze gukorwa mu masaka, soya n'ibigori. Soya yongeramo poroteyine n'ibinure, bityo igikoma cyayo kigira intungamubiri nyinshi kurusha igikoma cy'ikinyampeke kimwe. Giteke gifashe, ukikungahaze n'amata, amavuta make cyangwa ubunyobwa biseye. Yigure ahantu hasukuye kandi hizewe, kandi uyibike ahumutse kugira ngo itagwamo uruhumbu.

question: Ikivuguto ni cyiza ku bana?
paraphrases: Umwana wanjye yanywa ikivuguto?
Ikivuguto kiruta amata y'inshyushyu?
answer: Yego. Ikivuguto gikungahaye kuri poroteyine na kalisiyumu, kandi akenshi cyoroha gusya kurusha amata y'inshyushyu, bishobora gufasha abana bari gukira impiswi. Reba ko cyakozwe mu mata yatetswe cyangwa yatunganyijwe, kibikwa mu bikoresho bisukuye. Muhe nk'ikinyobwa guhera ku mezi 12, cyangwa uvange gike mu gikoma ku mpinja nto.

question: Umwana wanjye akwiye kurya umwijima kangahe?
paraphrases: Umwijima ni mwiza ku mpinja?
answer: Umwijima ni kimwe mu biryo bikungahaye cyane ku butare na vitamini A. Agace gato (hafi ibiyiko 1 cyangwa 2, bihiye neza kandi biseye) rimwe cyangwa kabiri mu cyumweru ni byiza cyane ku bana guhera ku mezi 6. Ntukamuhe mwinshi buri munsi, kuko umwijima ufite vitamini A nyinshi cyane. Umwijima w'inkoko, uw'ihene cyangwa uw'inka yose ni myiza.

question: Ibitoki ni ibiryo byiza ku bana?
paraphrases: Nshobora kugaburira uruhinja ibitoki?
answer: Ibitoki bitanga imbaraga, ariko kimwe n'imyumbati, bifite poroteyine nke. Ni byiza nk'ikiribwa cy'ibanze cy'ifunguro iyo wongeyemo ibyubaka umubiri n'imboga: sya ibitoki bitetse ubivange n'ibishyimbo cyangwa isosi y'ubunyobwa, udufi duto cyangwa igi, n'imboga z'icyatsi, n'amavuta make. Imineke yeze ni ifunguro ryiza hagati.

question: Ni ibihe biryo byo mu Rwanda bikungahaye kuri kalisiyumu ikomeza amagufa?
paraphrases: Ni ibihe biryo bifite kalisiyumu ku bana?
answer: Ibiryo bitanga kalisiyumu ni amata, ikivuguto na yawurute, udufi duto turiwe n'amagufa yatwo (isambaza, indagara, sardine), imboga z'icyatsi nka dodo n'isombe, soya n'ibishyimbo byera. Amashereka nayo atanga kalisiyumu. Kurya kimwe muri ibi biryo buri munsi bifasha abana kubaka amagufa n'amenyo akomeye.

question: Akarima k'igikoni gafasha gate imirire y'umwana wanjye?
paraphrases: Nahinga iki mu karima k'igikoni?
answer: Akarima gato k'igikoni hafi y'inzu gatanga imboga nshya buri munsi ku giciro gito. Ibyiza wahinga ni dodo, amashu, karoti, epinari, ibitunguru, inyanya, ibijumba by'umuhondo, ibishyimbo n'ibiti by'imbuto nk'ipapayi cyangwa avoka. Abajyanama b'ubuzima n'inyigisho zo guteka mu mudugudu wawe bashobora kukwereka uko bagakora. Korora inkoko nke nabyo bishobora gutanga amagi.

question: Ni izihe mbuto nziza ku bana bato mu Rwanda?
paraphrases: Ni uruhe rubuto naha uruhinja rwanjye?
answer: Imbuto nyinshi zo mu Rwanda ni nziza: umuneke weze, avoka, umwembe n'ipapayi (bikungahaye kuri vitamini A), amacunga, amapera, marakuja, ibinyomoro n'inanasi (bikungahaye kuri vitamini C), n'ibihaza by'amazi (watermelon). Zoze, uzihate cyangwa uzisye ku mpinja, kandi ukuremo imbuto zo imbere. Muhe imbuto zose aho kumuha umutobe, nibura rimwe ku munsi.

question: Nkwiye gukoresha umunyu urimo iyode?
paraphrases: Kuki iyode ari ingenzi ku bana?
answer: Yego. Koresha umunyu urimo iyode mu guteka ibiryo by'umuryango. Iyode ikenewe mu mikurire y'ubwonko bw'umwana no mu gutwita neza; kuyibura bishobora kugabanya ubwenge no gutera ibibyimba mu ijosi (goitre). Umunyu ukenewe ni muke. Ntugashyire umunyu mu biryo by'umwana utarageza ku mezi 12, kandi ubike umunyu mu kintu gipfundikiye kure y'ubushyuhe.

question: Amata ya soya ni meza ku bana?
paraphrases: Nshobora gutekera umwana wanjye igikoma cya soya?
answer: Soya ni kimwe mu bimera bitanga poroteyine nyinshi, kandi ifu ya soya mu gikoma (nka sosoma) ni nziza guhera ku mezi 6. Amata ya soya yakorewe mu rugo ashobora gukoreshwa mu gikoma cyangwa agahabwa abana barengeje amezi 12, ariko ntagomba gusimbura amashereka. Soya igomba gutekwa igashya neza. Hitamo ibikomoka kuri soya bitongewemo isukari.

question: Umwana w'imyaka 4 akwiye kurya iki mu munsi umwe?
paraphrases: Gahunda y'amafunguro y'umwana w'incuke
answer:
Urugero rw'umunsi ku mwana w'imyaka 4:
- Mu gitondo: igikombe cy'igikoma cya sosoma kirimo amata, n'umuneke.
- Hagati: ibijumba bitetse n'ubunyobwa biseye.
- Saa sita: ubugali cyangwa umuceri n'ibishyimbo, dodo itekeshejwe amavuta make, na avoka.
- Hagati: igikombe cy'ikivuguto cyangwa urubuto nk'icunga cyangwa ipapayi.
- Nimugoroba: ibirayi cyangwa ibitoki n'udufi duto cyangwa igi, n'imboga nk'amashu na karoti.
Ibi bitanga amafunguro 3 n'amafunguro mato 2 arimo ibitera imbaraga, ibyubaka umubiri n'ibirinda indwara. Koresha umunyu urimo iyode muke kandi umuhe amazi meza.

question: Ntegurira amafunguro y'umwana wanjye uri gukira imirire mibi iringaniye.
paraphrases: Umwana wanjye afite MUAC y'umuhondo, namuha ayahe mafunguro?
answer:
Umwana uri gukira akeneye imbaraga na poroteyine nyinshi mu mafunguro mato kenshi (inshuro 5 kugeza kuri 6 ku munsi) wongeyeho konsa:
- Mu museso: igikoma gitekeshejwe amata, kirimo utuyiko 2 tw'amavuta cyangwa ubunyobwa biseye.
- Mu gitondo hagati: avoka n'umuneke biseye.
- Saa sita: ibishyimbo biseye, umuceri cyangwa ibirayi, dodo n'igi, n'akayiko k'amavuta.
- Nyuma ya saa sita: ikivuguto cyangwa amata hamwe n'ibijumba bitetse.
- Nimugoroba: ibitoki cyangwa ibirayi n'ifu y'udufi duto na karoti.
- Mbere yo kuryama: igikombe gito cy'igikoma gikungahajwe.
Kurikiza ibiryo by'inyongera wahawe n'ikigo nderabuzima, kandi ujye mu isuzuma ryose. Garuka ako kanya niba umwana yanze kurya cyangwa arwaye.

question: Umwana wanjye ntarya inyama cyangwa amafi. Ashobora kubona indyo nziza?
paraphrases: Gahunda y'amafunguro y'umwana utarya inyama
answer: Yego, ariko ugomba kwitonda. Muhe amagi n'amata cyangwa ikivuguto buri munsi niba bishoboka, kuko bitanga poroteyine, vitamini B12 n'izindi ntungamubiri ziboneka cyane mu bikomoka ku matungo. Vanga ibishyimbo, amashaza cyangwa soya n'amasaka, ibigori cyangwa umuceri kugira ngo abone poroteyine nziza. Muhe imboga z'icyatsi hamwe n'urubuto rufite vitamini C kugira ngo abone ubutare, kandi wongeremo ubunyobwa biseye cyangwa avoka kugira ngo abone imbaraga. Niba umwana atarya na kimwe mu bikomoka ku matungo, ganira n'umuganga ku nyongera z'intungamubiri.

question: Ubugali n'ibishyimbo ni ifunguro ryiza ku mwana wanjye?
paraphrases: Umuceri n'ibishyimbo birahagije ku mwana muto?
answer: Ni ishingiro ryiza: ubugali butanga imbaraga naho ibishyimbo bigatanga poroteyine n'ubutare. Ushobora kurinoza wongeramo imboga nka dodo, isombe, amashu cyangwa karoti, amavuta make, n'urubuto nyuma y'ifunguro. Kongeramo igi, udufi duto cyangwa inyama nke inshuro nke mu cyumweru bituma ubutare bwinjira mu mubiri byoroshye. Indyo itandukanye mu munsi wose ifasha kurusha ifunguro rimwe.

question: Nategura nte amafunguro atandukanye y'icyumweru cy'umwana wanjye muto?
paraphrases: Inama zo gutegura amafunguro y'icyumweru y'umwana
answer:
Simburanya ibiryo kugira ngo buri munsi umwana abone nibura amoko 5 y'ibiryo:
- Ibiribwa by'ibanze: simburanya igikoma cy'amasaka, umuceri, ibirayi, ibijumba, ibitoki n'ubugali.
- Ibyubaka umubiri: ibishyimbo cyangwa amashaza iminsi myinshi; igi iminsi 3 kugeza kuri 4; udufi duto cyangwa inyama iminsi 2 kugeza kuri 3; umwijima rimwe mu cyumweru; amata cyangwa ikivuguto igihe bihari.
- Imboga: simburanya dodo, isombe, amashu, karoti, igihaza na epinari.
- Imbuto: rumwe buri munsi, uhindura bitewe n'igihembwe (umuneke, umwembe, ipapayi, avoka, icunga, ibinyomoro).
Teka inkono nini y'ibishyimbo ikoreshwe iminsi ibiri, kandi uhore ufite ifu y'amafi yo kongera mu biryo.

question: Umwana wanjye yanga imboga. Nazishyira nte mu mafunguro ye?
paraphrases: Umwana wanjye muto ntarya imboga z'icyatsi
answer: Zihishe kandi uzivange: kata dodo cyangwa epinari uduce duto cyane uzivange mu isosi y'ibishyimbo, mu gikoma cyangwa mu birayi biseye; sya karoti cyangwa igihaza ubivange n'ibijumba; kandi uteke imboga n'amavuta make n'ubunyobwa biseye kugira ngo ziryohe. Rya imboga imbere y'umwana, uzimuhe kenshi (bishobora gusaba kugerageza inshuro 10 cyangwa zirenga), kandi umushimire. Imbuto nk'umwembe n'ipapayi zitanga vitamini zisa n'izo mu mboga mu gihe ukomeje kugerageza.

question: Nkwiye guha umwana wanjye vitamini zigurwa mu maduka?
paraphrases: Ni izihe vitamini umwana wanjye akwiye gufata?
Nshobora guha umwana wanjye vitamini z'abantu bakuru?
answer: Abana benshi babona ibyo bakeneye mu mashereka no mu ndyo itandukanye, hamwe n'ibinini bya vitamini A n'iby'inzoka bitangwa ku kigo nderabuzima buri mezi atandatu. Ntukamuhe vitamini z'abantu bakuru cyangwa izindi nyongera utabigiriwemo inama n'umuganga, kuko vitamini zimwe n'ubutare bigira ingaruka mbi iyo ari byinshi. Niba utekereza ko umwana wawe akeneye inyongera, baza ku kigo nderabuzima.

question: Ni iyihe ndyo nkwiye gukurikiza ndwaye diyabete?
paraphrases: Nkwiye kurya iki mfite umuvuduko w'amaraso ukabije?
answer: Indyo y'umuntu urwaye diyabete cyangwa umuvuduko w'amaraso ukabije iterwa n'ubuzima bwawe n'imiti ufata, bityo saba inama umuganga cyangwa umuhanga mu by'imirire ku kigo nderabuzima. Njye nibanda ku mirire y'abana bato n'ababyeyi batwite cyangwa bonsa. Nishimiye kugufasha kuri ibyo.

question: Namenya nte ko uruhinja rwanjye rufashe ibere neza?
paraphrases: Imoko zandya iyo nonsa
answer: Ibimenyetso byerekana ko umwana afashe ibere neza: umunwa we urasamye cyane, umunwa wo hasi uhindukiriye hanze, akananwa gakora ku ibere, kandi igice cyirabura kizengurutse imoko kigaragara cyane hejuru y'umunwa kurusha hasi. Wumva yonka buhoro kandi cyane, amira, kandi ntibikubabaza. Kubabara cyangwa imoko zikomeretse akenshi biterwa no gufata ibere nabi; mukureho buhoro wongere ugerageze. Umuganga cyangwa umubyeyi ubimenyereye ashobora kugufasha.

question: Nakomeza nte konsa ngarutse ku kazi?
paraphrases: Nkora mu murima, umwana wanjye yabona ate amashereka?
Nakama nte amashereka?
answer: Kama amashereka n'intoki uyashyire mu gikombe gisukuye mbere yo kugenda, maze umurezi azayahe umwana akoresheje igikombe gisukuye (atari icupa). Amashereka yakamwe ashobora kumara amasaha 4 hafi apfundikiye ari ku bushyuhe busanzwe, cyangwa igihe kirekire ahantu hakonje cyangwa muri firigo. Onsa kenshi igihe uri kumwe n'umwana, harimo na nijoro. Niba bishoboka, jyana umwana aho ukorera cyangwa uze mu rugo konsa ku manywa.

question: Umubyeyi ufite virusi itera SIDA ashobora konsa?
paraphrases: Mfite virusi itera SIDA, nkwiye konsa umwana wanjye?
answer: Mu Rwanda, ababyeyi babana na virusi itera SIDA bakunze kugirwa inama yo konsa mu gihe bafata imiti igabanya ubukana (ARV) buri munsi, igabanya cyane ibyago byo kwanduza umwana. Onsa gusa mu mezi 6 ya mbere, hanyuma ukomeze hamwe n'ibindi biryo nk'uko ubigirwamo inama. Abaganga bazaha n'umwana imiti imurinda kandi bamupime. Kurikiza neza inama z'ikigo nderabuzima cyawe.

question: Kuki kwipimisha inda ari ingenzi ku mirire y'umwana wanjye?
paraphrases: Nkwiye kwipimisha inda inshuro zingahe?
answer: Kwipimisha inda bisuzuma ibiro, amaraso n'ubuzima bw'umubyeyi, bigatanga ibinini by'ubutare na aside folike, n'inama ku kurya neza, ibyo byose bifasha umwana gukura neza mbere yo kuvuka. Tangira kwipimisha inda hakiri kare, kandi ujye mu isuzuma ryose ikigo nderabuzima kiguteganyirije. Umwana ukura neza mu nda atangira ubuzima afite ibyago bike byo kugwingira.

question: Ni byiza kunywa inzoga igihe utwite cyangwa wonsa?
paraphrases: Nshobora kunywa urwagwa ntwite?
answer: Oya. Inzoga, harimo n'iza gakondo nk'urwagwa n'ikigage, zigera ku mwana zinyuze mu ngobyi no mu mashereka, kandi zishobora kwangiza ubwonko bw'umwana n'imikurire ye. Nta rugero rw'inzoga rutekanye ku mugore utwite. Irinde inzoga igihe utwite n'igihe wonsa, uhitemo amazi, amata cyangwa igikoma.

question: Kuki ngomba kurinda umwana wanjye amase n'amabyi y'amatungo?
paraphrases: Inkoko ziba mu nzu zishobora gutera umwana wanjye uburwayi?
answer: Amase n'amabyi y'amatungo arimo mikorobe zitera impiswi no kwangirika kw'amara igihe kirekire, bikabuza abana gukura intungamubiri kandi bishobora gutera kugwingira n'iyo barya neza. Amatungo n'inkoko bigume hanze y'inzu n'aho abana bakinira, uhe abana umusambi usukuye wo gukiniraho, kandi ubakarabye intoki kenshi. Ibiraro by'amatungo bigume kure y'aho utegurira ibiryo.

question: Igikoni cy'umudugudu ni iki?
paraphrases: Ni iki gikorerwa mu gikoni cy'umudugudu?
answer: Igikoni cy'umudugudu ni aho ababyeyi, abagabo n'abarezi biga gutegura amafunguro afite intungamubiri ku bana bakoresheje ibiryo byo mu gace batuyemo, binyuze mu kwerekana uko bateka biyobowe n'abajyanama b'ubuzima n'abakorerabushake. Abana badakura neza bashobora no kugaburirirwamo. Ni ahantu heza ho kwigira uko bategura igikoma gikungahajwe n'amafunguro yuzuye. Baza umujyanama w'ubuzima igihe ibikorwa biba.

question: Umwana mukuru ni we urera uruhinja rwanjye igihe ndi ku kazi. Nakora nte ngo uruhinja rurye neza?
paraphrases: Umwana wanjye arerwa n'abandi ku manywa
answer: Tegura amafunguro y'uruhinja mbere, wereke umurezi ingano akwiye kumuha n'uko amugaburira yihanganye akoresheje igikombe n'ikiyiko. Niba uruhinja rukiri ruto, siga amashereka yakamwe mu gikombe gisukuye gipfundikiye. Igisha umurezi gukaraba intoki mbere yo kugaburira. Musabe kukubwira niba uruhinja rwanze kurya. Onsa kenshi mu gitondo, nimugoroba na nijoro igihe muri kumwe.

question: Umwana wanjye arya buhoro cyane kandi akarangara. Nakora iki?
paraphrases: Umwana wanjye akina aho kurya
answer: Icarana n'umwana ahantu hatuje, kure ya televiziyo, telefoni n'ibikinisho, umuhe isahani ye. Muvugishe kandi umutere inkunga, umureke akore ku biryo kandi yigaburire, umuhe ingano nto ashobora kurangiza. Muhe igihe gihagije ariko urangize ifunguro nyuma y'iminota 20 kugeza kuri 30, hanyuma umuhe ifunguro rito ryiza nyuma. Ntukamuhatire cyangwa ngo umuhane; amasaha ahoraho yo kurya afasha abana kumenya kurya neza.
